listing.name: Yoshi's Island: Super Mario Advance 3 / SMA3 Recomp Android (Edwin2929)
listing.summary: Explore Yoshi's Island: Super Mario Advance 3 / SMA3 Recomp Android (Edwin2929) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: The upstream guide describes this Android ARM64 setup: CHOOSE ROM for your own Yoshi’s Island: Super Mario Advance 3 USA ROM, CHOOSE BIOS for your own GBA BIOS, then PLAY. It identifies the 4,194,304-byte ROM by SHA-1 7352d2bd064d9ebaec579e264228aa21c7345b80 and the 16,384-byte BIOS by SHA-1 300c20df6731a33952ded8c436f7f186d25d3492. The published APK names a different version from that guide, so check its release instructions before changing a working copy. Portcove supplies neither original file.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: The published APK and setup guide name different versions (0.9 and 0.4). The input and save-transfer details for that APK are still being checked. Keep existing saves, app data and your originals separately before changing builds; a locally signed build cannot update a differently signed app in place. Preserve a working copy’s data before any uninstall required by a signing change.
